_about: Film styles the motion designer can be handed as a whole visual bible (factory/capabilities.py turns each into a 'style.<id>' technique). Each one says what the medium IS and is NOT, how to render it in code here (CSS / SVG / canvas / Three.js + fxlib), composition, colour logic, type, motion quality, camera grammar, its own native transitions and its sound palette. post = film texture added in ffmpeg after capture (never drawn in the page: grain in the page makes every frame slow and incompressible). Written for this studio; references teach grammar only.

styles.name: Risograph print
styles.essence: Looks printed one ink at a time: 2-3 translucent spot inks on warm off-white paper, overprints make the extra colours, halftone dots for mid-tones, plates a few px out of register.
styles.not: Not flat vector with a noise overlay, not CMYK pop-art, no outlines, no gradients except stepped halftone.
styles.render: Draw each ink as its own layer (div / svg group) with mix-blend-mode: multiply over paper #f4eee2; each layer gets a fixed offset of 1-3 px per shot (misregistration), a kick of ~10 px decaying in 0.25 s on accents; halftone via CSS radial-gradient dots (period 7 px) masked onto shapes; a paper-white knockout halo (4 px) around characters.
styles.composition: Big flat fields, one horizon, one small figure in a large world; every area uses at most two inks, one of them as a tint.
styles.colour: 2-3 inks only, e.g. blue #0078bf + fluorescent pink #ff48b0 + yellow #ffe800, or teal #00838a + orange #ff7477; paper is a colour; save the full three-ink overprint for the peak.
styles.type: Heavy grotesque titles (Montserrat 900) printed on one ink with a visible double-hit offset; captions on a paper-white knockout strip.
styles.motion: Characters on twos (12 fps), camera smooth; registration fixed per shot, never jittering every frame.
styles.camera: Wide lateral tracking with a small figure; locked composition for the one pause; push into the halftone until dots become shapes.
styles.transitions: A roller sweep that adds the next ink; an overprint growing over the frame; a match cut on a flat shape. Never a cross-dissolve.
styles.sound: Warm, dry, handmade: upright bass, vibraphone or marimba, brushed kit, shaker; each new ink can bring one instrument.

tr.look: Tek tek basılmış gibi: sıcak kâğıt üstünde 2-3 yarı saydam mürekkep, üst üste binen renkler, kaymış kalıplar.
tr.type: Ağır, kalın başlıklar; tek mürekkeple, hafif çift baskı.
tr.motion: Kâğıt kesik gibi kararlı hareketler; vurguda kalıp bir an kayar.
tr.sound: Kontrbas, vibrafon, fırçalı davul; sıcak ve kuru.
tr.avoid: Gradyan, kontur, CMYK pop-art, düz vektöre gürültü eklemek.

en.look: Printed one ink at a time: 2-3 translucent inks on warm paper, overprints, plates slightly out of register.
en.type: Heavy grotesque titles on one ink with a visible double hit.
en.motion: Decisive, paper-like moves; plates kick out of register on accents.
en.sound: Upright bass, vibraphone, brushed kit; warm and dry.
en.avoid: Gradients, outlines, CMYK pop art, flat vector with a noise overlay.

styles.name: Ink wash
styles.essence: Black ink brushed on rice paper: wet edges, dry-brush strokes, large empty paper, one seal-red accent.
styles.not: Not a font on a beige gradient; no outlines everywhere; never fill the frame.
styles.render: SVG paths with variable stroke widths drawn on (FX.drawOn) + feTurbulence displacement for the dry edge (FX.boil with px 2-3); washes as blurred low-opacity shapes; paper #efe9dc with a fibre noise layer.
styles.composition: Two thirds empty paper; the subject on a third line; mountains and mist as layered washes getting paler with distance.
styles.colour: Ink #161513 in 3 dilutions, paper, ONE red #c8372d (the seal, the danger, the sun).
styles.type: Few words; Cormorant Garamond or Instrument Serif, small, vertical stacks allowed.
styles.motion: Slow, calm, sine easing; a stroke draws itself as the voice says it; long holds.
styles.camera: Slow vertical pans down a scroll; a push through mist layers.
styles.transitions: Ink blooming into the next scene; a brush stroke that wipes across and becomes the horizon.
styles.sound: Guqin / koto-like plucks, a low flute, wind, water drips; long silences.

tr.look: Kâğıda fırçayla mürekkep: üç tonda siyah, bol boşluk, tek kırmızı mühür.
tr.type: Az kelime, küçük serif; dikey dizilebilir.
tr.motion: Yavaş, nefes alan; mürekkep yayılarak belirir.
tr.avoid: Kalabalık kare, parlak renkler, sert kesmeler.

en.look: Brush ink on paper: black in three dilutions, a lot of empty space, one red seal.
en.type: Few words, small serif; vertical stacks allowed.
en.motion: Slow and breathing; ink spreads into place.
en.avoid: Busy frames, bright colours, hard cuts.

styles.name: Cut-paper diorama
styles.essence: Layered cut card stock in depth: every shape is a flat paper piece with a soft drop shadow on the one behind it.
styles.not: Not flat vector; no gradients inside a piece; no outlines.
styles.render: Absolutely positioned divs / SVG paths with irregular edges, box-shadow 0 6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25); 4-6 depth layers moving at different speeds (parallax); a faint paper texture per colour.
styles.composition: Foreground framing pieces, a midground stage, a background sky; the subject on the midground.
styles.colour: Warm matte card colours, max 5 per scene, one saturated accent.
styles.type: Titles cut from paper: Shrikhand or Montserrat 800 with the same drop shadow.
styles.motion: Pieces slide in on arcs with a small overshoot (paper 3-5 %), hinge up from the floor, on twos for characters.
styles.camera: Lateral parallax tracking; a push through the layers into the next scene.
styles.transitions: A layer slides across and becomes the next set; a pop-up fold.
styles.sound: Paper rustles and slides, felt and wood knocks, music box, pizzicato strings.

tr.look: Katman katman kesilmiş karton: yumuşak gölgeler, mat dokular, derinlik.
tr.motion: Katmanlar ayrı hızlarda kayar (paralaks); parçalar kâğıt gibi sallanarak oturur.
tr.sound: Kalimba, ukulele, el çırpma; neşeli ve el yapımı.
tr.avoid: Parlak yüzey, 3D render görünümü, beşten fazla renk.

en.look: Layered cut card: soft drop shadows, matte textures, depth.
en.type: Titles cut from paper with the same drop shadow.
en.motion: Layers slide at different speeds (parallax); pieces settle with a paper wobble.
en.sound: Kalimba, ukulele, hand claps; cheerful and handmade.
en.avoid: Glossy surfaces, a 3D-render look, more than five colours.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.essence: A technical drawing that draws itself: white and light-cyan lines on cobalt, dimensions, callouts and section cuts that explain how a thing works.
styles.not: Not a generic HUD; no glow; no 3D renders.
styles.render: SVG strokes (FX.drawOn) with a fine 40 px grid; dimension lines with arrowheads and numbers; hatching for sections; occasional exploded views built from the same lines.
styles.composition: The object centred and large; callouts outside it on a clean grid; one detail circle that zooms in.
styles.colour: Cobalt #1d3f8f ground, white #f2f6ff lines, light cyan #8fd3ff for secondary, one amber #ffb547 for the key part.
styles.type: Monospace-like caps (Inter Tight 600, wide tracking) for labels; numbers always with units.
styles.motion: Lines draw on in build order (outline -> details -> dimensions), linear only for the drawing pen, eased for camera.
styles.camera: Pushes into a detail circle; pans along an assembly; an exploded view separating on one axis.
styles.transitions: The current drawing gets erased by a sweeping line; zoom through a detail circle into the next sheet.
styles.sound: Pencil and drafting sounds as light ticks, a clean minimal synth pulse, a soft click per callout.

tr.look: Kobalt zeminde beyaz teknik çizim: ölçü çizgileri, ızgara, tek kehribar vurgu.
tr.type: Geniş aralıklı büyük harf etiketler; sayılar birimiyle.
tr.motion: Çizgiler kendini çizer; kamera parçaya yaklaşır, patlatılmış görünüm.
tr.sound: Minimal elektronik, mekanik tıkırtılar, düşük nabız.
tr.avoid: Fotoğraf, gölge, dekoratif yazı tipi, birimsiz sayı.

en.look: White technical drawing on cobalt: dimension lines, grid, one amber highlight.
en.type: Wide-tracked caps for labels; numbers always with units.
en.motion: Lines draw themselves; the camera moves into a part, exploded views.
en.sound: Minimal electronics, mechanical clicks, a low pulse.
en.avoid: Photos, drop shadows, decorative fonts, numbers without units.

styles.name: Archive newsreel
styles.essence: A 1930s-60s newsreel: black-and-white or sepia, gate weave, flicker, film grain, bold title cards with an announcer's urgency.
styles.not: Not a sepia filter over modern graphics; no flat UI; no modern sans titles.
styles.render: Monochrome scenes (CSS filter grayscale/sepia on the scene), vintage cards with heavy borders; photos from the open-licence stock pipeline where real; the texture (grain, flicker, weave, vignette) comes from the post-pass.
styles.composition: Centred, symmetric title cards; photos framed with a thick black edge; maps with an animated line.
styles.colour: Black, white, greys or sepia; at most one hand-tinted colour.
styles.type: Anton or Playfair Display 900 caps on title cards; small serif captions.
styles.motion: Quick, jaunty moves; title cards slam in; maps draw routes.
styles.camera: Slow pushes on photos (Ken Burns), sudden snap zooms on a detail.
styles.transitions: Iris in / out to black; a quick whip; a flash frame.
styles.sound: Brass fanfare-like stabs, a marching snare, crowd murmur, projector rattle under everything.

tr.look: Eski film: siyah-beyaz ya da sepya, gren, titreme, çerçeve kayması.
tr.type: Ara yazı kartlarında büyük harf, küçük serif alt yazılar.
tr.motion: Kesik kesik, döneminin kamerası; ara yazı kartlarıyla bölünür.
tr.avoid: Temiz dijital görüntü, doygun renk, modern geçişler.

en.look: Old film: black and white or sepia, grain, flicker, gate weave.
en.type: Caps on title cards, small serif captions.
en.motion: Period camera, a little jerky; broken up by title cards.
en.avoid: Clean digital picture, saturated colour, modern transitions.

styles.name: Swiss grid motion
styles.essence: International typographic style in motion: a strict grid, huge type, red, black and white, information as composition.
styles.not: No decoration, no gradients, no shadows, no illustrations; nothing off the grid.
styles.render: CSS grid of 12 columns; text blocks that snap to columns; rules and blocks of solid colour; numbers enormous.
styles.composition: Asymmetric, left-aligned, lots of white; one red element per frame.
styles.type: Inter Tight 800-900 tight tracking for headlines, 500 for body; flush left, ragged right.
styles.motion: Snappy (power3.out 0.3-0.45 s), blocks slide along the grid, text masks; everything lands and holds.
styles.camera: No camera wobble: cuts and slides along the grid lines.
styles.transitions: A colour block sweeps across a column; type pushes the previous type off the grid.
styles.sound: Precise: tight clicks, a minimal techno pulse, crisp ticks on every snap.

tr.look: Sıkı ızgara, beyaz zemin, siyah tipografi, tek kırmızı.
tr.type: Sıkı aralıklı kalın başlıklar, sola dayalı.
tr.motion: Izgaraya oturan net kaymalar; her şey hizada.
tr.avoid: Ortalanmış yazı, süs, gölge, üçten fazla renk.

en.look: A strict grid, white ground, black type, one red.
en.motion: Crisp slides that land on the grid; everything aligned.
en.avoid: Centred text, ornament, shadows, more than three colours.

styles.name: Retro cel animation
styles.essence: Hand-painted cel look: flat colours with one hard shadow shape, speed lines, sunset gradients, glints, on twos.
styles.not: No soft 3D shading, no photo backgrounds, no modern flat UI.
styles.render: SVG shapes with flat fills + one hard-edged shadow shape each; painted gradient skies; speed-line fields for action; FX.boil lightly on outlines; characters with FX.stickman or custom SVG on twos.
styles.composition: Dramatic low angles, big foreground silhouettes, a horizon low in the frame.
styles.colour: Saturated sunset magentas, violets and oranges; deep blue shadows; one glint white.
styles.type: Shrikhand or Anton with a hard offset shadow, maybe chrome-gradient titles.
styles.motion: Characters on twos with strong anticipation; impact frames (one frame flash + speed lines); held poses.
styles.camera: Pan across a long background, a push on a face, a shake on impact.
styles.transitions: Smash cut on an impact frame; a white flash; a wipe made of speed lines.
styles.sound: Synth-pop bass and gated drums, brassy synth stabs, whooshes on every big move, a sparkle on glints.

tr.look: 80'ler cel animasyonu: gün batımı pembeleri, morlar, sert gölgeler, parıltılar.
tr.type: Sert gölgeli ya da krom başlıklar.
tr.motion: Az kareli, hızlı poz değişimleri, hız çizgileri.

en.look: 80s cel animation: sunset magentas and violets, hard shadows, glints.
en.type: Titles with a hard offset shadow or chrome.
en.motion: Animated on twos, snappy poses, speed lines.

styles.name: Hologram HUD
styles.essence: Sci-fi interface projected in space: thin cyan lines, scanlines, data rings, glitches, everything assembled from light.
styles.not: Not a dashboard screenshot; no heavy fills; no paper textures.
styles.render: SVG thin strokes, rings and ticks drawn on; additive glow via CSS text/box-shadow; scanline overlay; FX.scramble for labels; occasional FX.three for a wireframe object.
styles.composition: A central object with rings and callouts orbiting it; data panels at the edges of the safe area.
styles.colour: Near-black #05080d, cyan #3df0ff, a warning orange #ff8a3d only for danger.
styles.type: Inter Tight 500 caps, wide tracking, small; numbers that count.
styles.motion: Precise build-ons, ticking counters, short glitches (2-3 frames) on state changes.
styles.camera: Orbit around the object; push into a panel.
styles.transitions: A glitch tear; panels folding into lines and re-expanding into the next scene.
styles.sound: Soft synth beeps (sparingly), a low drone, data ticks, a power-up swell on reveals.

tr.look: Koyu zeminde camgöbeği arayüz: halkalar, ölçekler, parlayan çizgiler.
tr.type: Küçük, geniş aralıklı büyük harf; sayılar sayarak gelir.
tr.motion: Taramalar, açılan halkalar, sayaçlar; yalnız tehlikede turuncu.
tr.sound: Sentez darbeleri, arayüz bipleri, alçak uğultu.
tr.avoid: Kalabalık ekran, birden fazla vurgu rengi, okunmayan küçük yazı.

en.look: A cyan interface on near-black: rings, scales, glowing lines.
en.type: Small wide-tracked caps; numbers count up.
en.motion: Scans, opening rings, counters; orange only for danger.
en.sound: Synth pulses, UI blips, a low hum.
en.avoid: Cluttered screens, more than one accent, unreadably small text.

styles.name: Woodcut
styles.essence: Carved black lines on rough paper: gouge marks, bold silhouettes, one accent colour block printed slightly off.
styles.not: No thin even lines, no gradients, no soft shadows.
styles.render: SVG shapes in black with carved white gouge strokes (tapered paths) cut out of them; paper texture; one colour layer multiply-blended and offset 2 px.
styles.composition: Symbolic, poster-like; one big shape, strong diagonals.
styles.colour: Black, paper #efe6d2, one accent (red #b8322a or ochre #c9902e).
styles.type: Anton caps with rough edges, or Playfair Display 900.
styles.motion: Stop-motion feel on twos; pieces stamp in with a small shake; long holds.
styles.camera: Mostly locked; slow pushes; cuts between symbolic close-ups.
styles.transitions: A carved line sweeps across; a stamp-in of the next block.
styles.sound: Wooden percussion, low frame drum, a single folk melody, paper and stamp thuds.

tr.look: Oyma baskı: kalın siyah formlar, tarama çizgileri, kâğıt dokusu, tek vurgu rengi.
tr.motion: Ağır, kararlı; baskı gibi bir anda belirir.
tr.avoid: Gri tonlar, yumuşak gölge, ince çizgi.

en.look: Carved print: heavy black shapes, hatching, paper texture, one accent.
en.motion: Heavy and decisive; appears like a print being pulled.

styles.name: Miniature world
styles.essence: A tiny toy world in 3D: shallow depth of field (tilt-shift), soft daylight, rounded toy shapes.
styles.not: Not realistic 3D; no sharp everything-in-focus frames.
styles.render: FX.set3d with the daylight or product rig, a 50-85 mm lens, rounded boxes and cylinders; blur bands top and bottom of the frame (backdrop-filter blur in two gradient-masked divs) to fake tilt-shift.
styles.composition: High angle looking down at the scene; the subject in the sharp band; repeated small props.
styles.colour: Saturated toy colours, warm light, soft blue shadows.
styles.type: Rounded heavy sans (Poppins 700) on small signs inside the world.
styles.motion: Things move slightly fast (toy speed); small bounces on landings; little vehicles on paths.
styles.camera: A slow dolly across the tabletop; a crane down into a detail.
styles.transitions: The camera flies over a building into the next block; a tilt up into the sky and down into the next place.
styles.sound: Toy-like: marimba, glockenspiel, ukulele-free light percussion, tiny foley pitched up.

tr.look: Oyuncak dünya: doygun renkler, sıcak ışık, üst ve altta bulanıklık (tilt-shift).
tr.type: Dünyanın içindeki küçük tabelalarda yuvarlak kalın yazı.
tr.motion: Yukarıdan bakan yavaş kamera, hızlandırılmış küçük hareketler.
tr.avoid: Gerçekçi ölçek, soğuk renkler, sert gölge.

en.look: A toy world: saturated colours, warm light, blur at top and bottom (tilt-shift).
en.type: Rounded heavy type on small signs inside the world.
en.motion: A slow camera from above, small sped-up movements.
en.avoid: Realistic scale, cold colours, hard shadows.

styles.name: Chalkboard
styles.essence: A teacher's board: dusty chalk lines drawn by hand, smudges, coloured chalk for emphasis, diagrams that build as the voice explains.
styles.not: No clean vector, no fills, no fonts that look typed.
styles.render: SVG strokes with a rough texture (FX.boil px 1.5 + a dotted stroke-dasharray for chalk grain), drawn on in order; a dark green-black board #1f2b26 with smudge layers.
styles.composition: Diagram in the middle, labels around it, one boxed conclusion.
styles.colour: Chalk white, yellow #f3e37a and pink #f29bb5 chalk for emphasis.
styles.type: Hand-drawn feel: Cormorant italic or Instrument Serif italic in chalk white.
styles.motion: Lines draw at a hand's pace; underlines and circles appear on the key word.
styles.camera: Pans along the board; a push on the conclusion.
styles.transitions: A wipe like a board eraser sweep.
styles.sound: Chalk scratches as soft ticks, a light piano, room tone of a classroom.

tr.look: Kara tahta: tebeşir beyazı, sarı ve pembe vurgular, silinmiş izler.
tr.type: El yazısı hissi veren italik serif.
tr.motion: Çizgiler elle çiziliyor gibi; okla, daireyle anlatır.
tr.sound: Akustik gitar, tebeşir sesi, sınıf ortamı.
tr.avoid: Düz renk dolgular, parlak neon, kusursuz geometri.

en.look: A chalkboard: chalk white, yellow and pink for emphasis, smudged erasures.
en.type: Italic serif with a handwritten feel.
en.motion: Lines draw as if by hand; explains with arrows and circles.
en.sound: Acoustic guitar, chalk scratches, a classroom room tone.
en.avoid: Flat colour fills, bright neon, perfect geometry.

styles.name: Noir
styles.essence: High-contrast black and white: hard light, venetian-blind shadows, silhouettes, rain, one colour for the clue.
styles.not: No mid-grey mush; no bright cheerful colours.
styles.render: Black and white shapes with hard shadow stripes (repeating-linear-gradient), silhouettes (FX.stickman in black on a lit wall), rain as seeded line particles; the post-pass adds grain and vignette.
styles.composition: Low key, deep shadows, Dutch angles, a figure in a doorway of light.
styles.colour: Black, white, one red #d62828 (the clue, the danger).
styles.type: Playfair Display or DM Serif Display in white, small, like an old title card.
styles.motion: Slow, tense; a cigarette-smoke-like drift; sudden cuts on reveals.
styles.camera: Slow push on a face; a tilt across shadows; a sudden snap zoom on the clue.
styles.transitions: Cut to black; a shadow sweeping across the frame.
styles.sound: Muted trumpet, upright bass walking, rain bed, distant sirens, footsteps.

tr.look: Kara film: derin siyahlar, jaluzi gölgeleri, sis, tek kırmızı ipucu.
tr.type: Eski jenerik gibi küçük beyaz serif.
tr.motion: Yavaş kayan ışık, siluetler, sert gölgeler.

en.look: Film noir: deep blacks, venetian-blind shadows, haze, one red clue.
en.type: Small white serif, like an old title card.
en.motion: Slowly moving light, silhouettes, hard shadows.

styles.name: Sketchnote notebook
styles.essence: Explained with a pen on white paper, xkcd and whiteboard style: wobbly hand-drawn strokes, boxes, arrows and stick figures; every line is drawn on while the voice says it; one marker colour does the emphasis.
styles.not: Not chalk on a dark board (that is chalkboard), not clean vector icons, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no photos.
styles.render: SVG paths with hand jitter (rough.js idea: each stroke drawn twice with 1-2 px random offsets and slightly overshooting ends, seeded so it never boils unless asked); draw-on with stroke-dashoffset; rough-notation style annotations (circle, underline, box, highlight) drawn over words on the beat; charts as xkcd charts (wobbly axes, hand labels). Paper #fbfaf6 with faint blue ruled lines.
styles.composition: One idea per page: a big diagram in the middle, a hand label on each part, arrows doing the explaining; lots of white space; stick figures for people.
styles.colour: Ink #1d1d1f on paper #fbfaf6; ONE marker colour for emphasis (coral #ff5a4e or highlighter yellow #ffe14d as a fill behind words); a pale blue #a8c4e6 for ruled lines only.
styles.type: Hand-lettered look: Instrument Serif italic for labels, heavy Anton caps only for the one headline word; underlined, never boxed by a clean rectangle.
styles.motion: Strokes draw on in the order a hand would draw them (0.3-0.6 s each, ease-out); annotations land on the stressed word; a gentle 'boil' (re-seed every 4 frames) only on the hero drawing.
styles.camera: Mostly locked like a page on a desk; slide to the next part of a big drawing; push in on a detail as if leaning over the paper.
styles.transitions: Page turn; the drawing is scribbled out and a new one drawn; an arrow pulls the camera to the next idea; a quick eraser wipe.
styles.sound: Pen and marker scratches on draw-on, paper rustle on page turns, light ukulele / pizzicato / glockenspiel bed.

tr.look: Beyaz kâğıtta kalemle anlatım: titrek çizgiler, oklar, kutular, çöp adamlar; tek renk keçeli vurgu.
tr.type: El yazısı havasında italik etiketler; tek kelimelik kalın başlık, altı çizili.
tr.motion: Çizgiler, eli takip eder gibi sırayla çizilir; vurgu daireleri vurgulanan kelimede düşer.
tr.sound: Kalem ve keçeli cızırtısı, kâğıt hışırtısı, ukulele ve pizzicato.
tr.avoid: Koyu zemin, düzgün vektör ikon, gölge, parıltı, gradyan.

en.look: Pen on white paper: wobbly strokes, arrows, boxes, stick figures; one marker colour for emphasis.
en.type: Hand-lettered italic labels; one heavy underlined headline word.
en.motion: Strokes draw on in the order a hand would; annotation circles land on the stressed word.
en.sound: Pen and marker scratches, paper rustle, ukulele and pizzicato.
en.avoid: Dark boards, clean vector icons, shadows, glow, gradients.

styles.name: VHS home tape
styles.essence: A home video from the late 80s / 90s played back on a worn VCR: soft picture, colour bleeding sideways, red and blue planes slipping apart, tracking noise rolling through, a white on-screen 'PLAY' and date stamp.
styles.not: Not black-and-white newsreel film (that is archive_film), not a digital glitch with pixel blocks, not a cyberpunk neon HUD, not crisp 4K.
styles.render: Draw the scene clean in the page in a 4:3-feel safe area, slightly oversaturated warm colours; OSD text (PLAY ▶, REC ●, date 'OCT 12 1994', counter 00:00:13) in white caps with a hard 3 px black shadow; scanlines as a static repeating-linear-gradient overlay (opacity .12); tracking band = a 40-80 px tall bright noisy strip that rolls down the frame now and then (keyframed, not every frame). The colour slip, chroma smear and grain come from the post (chroma), not from the page.
styles.composition: Home-video framing: subjects a little off-centre, horizon a little tilted, big title cards of the 'family tape' kind; keep the OSD corners clear.
styles.colour: Warm tape colours: lifted blacks #1a1420, warm reds #e8452c, faded teal #3fb0a8, cream highlights #f4e9cf; OSD always pure white #ffffff with black shadow; blue screen #1734d6 for 'no signal' cuts.
styles.type: OSD: Inter Tight 700 caps, wide tracking, white with hard black drop shadow; titles in Anton as if made with a 90s titler, maybe with a rainbow gradient stroke.
styles.motion: Footage-like handheld drift; zooms are fast and a bit clumsy (camcorder rocker); pause = a held frame with a jittering tracking band; rewind = fast scrubbing with horizontal lines.
styles.camera: Camcorder grammar: snap zoom, slow pan, a wobble when the 'operator' moves; no smooth dolly.
styles.transitions: Tape stop (picture squeezes, blue screen), rewind scrub, a tracking roll, a hard cut to the next 'recording' with a new date stamp.
styles.sound: Tape hiss, VCR motor clunks on play/stop, warbly lo-fi synth or Casio keyboard bed, the music slightly wow-and-fluttering.

tr.look: 90'lardan kalma ev videosu: yumuşak görüntü, kayan renkler, iz bozulması, köşede PLAY ve tarih.
tr.type: Beyaz büyük harf ekran yazısı, sert siyah gölgeli; 90'lar başlık jeneratörü havası.
tr.motion: Kamera elde, beceriksizce hızlı zoom; durdurunca titreyen bant, geri sarma çizgileri.
tr.sound: Bant cızırtısı, video oynatıcı tıkırtıları, dalgalanan lo-fi synth.
tr.avoid: Siyah-beyaz film makarası, piksel blok glitch'i, neon HUD, keskin 4K.

en.look: A 90s home tape on a worn VCR: soft picture, slipping colours, tracking noise, PLAY and a date stamp.
en.type: White caps on-screen display with a hard black shadow; 90s titler headlines.
en.motion: Handheld drift, clumsy snap zooms; a jittering band on pause, scan lines on rewind.
en.sound: Tape hiss, VCR clunks, warbly lo-fi synth.
en.avoid: Black-and-white newsreel, pixel-block glitches, neon HUD, crisp 4K.

styles.name: Retro desktop (Windows 95)
styles.essence: The story told on a mid-90s computer desktop: grey bevelled windows, title bars, dialog boxes, progress bars and error pop-ups open one by one; the interface itself is the explainer.
styles.not: Not a modern flat UI, not macOS glass, not a screen recording of a real app, not a terminal hacker screen; no rounded corners, no blur.
styles.render: Pure CSS like React95: window = #c3c3c3 panel with 2 px bevel (border white top-left, #808080 / #000 bottom-right), title bar linear-gradient(90deg,#000080,#1084d0) with white bold title and three square buttons; teal desktop #008080; pixel-crisp: no border-radius, no shadows except the bevel; icons as 32 px chunky shapes; a pointer cursor that clicks things.
styles.composition: Windows stack and overlap like a messy desktop; the key fact sits in a dialog box with an OK button; progress bars measure numbers; a taskbar with START at the bottom.
styles.colour: Desktop teal #008080, panel grey #c3c3c3, title navy #000080 to #1084d0, text black, highlight selection navy with white text; one warning yellow #ffff00 icon for errors.
styles.type: System look: Inter Tight 700 at small sizes for UI text, Anton only inside a big 'WordArt' style title; numbers in progress bars.
styles.motion: Windows pop open with a 3-frame zoom outline (no easing), the cursor glides then clicks, progress bars fill in blocky steps, error dialogs cascade; everything snaps, nothing floats.
styles.camera: Locked on the screen; occasional punch in on a dialog, like zooming into a screenshot.
styles.transitions: A window minimises to the taskbar; a new window opens over the old; the screen saver kicks in; a blue-screen cut for the twist.
styles.sound: Mouse clicks, the startup chime idea (original, not the real one), dialog 'ding', hard-drive whirr, a light MIDI bed.

tr.look: 90'ların bilgisayar masaüstü: gri kabartmalı pencereler, diyalog kutuları, hata pencereleri, ilerleme çubukları.
tr.type: Küçük sistem yazısı; büyük başlıklar WordArt havasında.
tr.motion: Pencereler takır takır açılır, imleç tıklar, çubuklar blok blok dolar; hiçbir şey süzülmez.
tr.sound: Fare tıkları, uyarı 'ding'i, disk vızıltısı, hafif MIDI müzik.
tr.avoid: Modern düz arayüz, yuvarlak köşe, bulanık cam, gerçek uygulama kaydı.

en.look: A 90s desktop: grey bevelled windows, dialog boxes, error pop-ups, progress bars.
en.type: Small system UI text; big titles as WordArt.
en.motion: Windows snap open, the cursor clicks, bars fill in blocks; nothing floats.
en.sound: Mouse clicks, a dialog ding, drive whirr, a light MIDI bed.
en.avoid: Modern flat UI, rounded corners, glass blur, real app recordings.

styles.name: Isometric explainer
styles.essence: Flat vector worlds seen at a 30 degree isometric angle: machines, buildings and systems built from clean boxes; tiny figures, pipes and flows show how a thing works step by step.
styles.not: Not a tilt-shift photo of a toy world (that is miniature), not true 3D with perspective, no realistic textures, no heavy gradients.
styles.render: Isometric projection in SVG: every box = three faces (top lightest, left mid, right darkest) from one hue; grid of 2:1 rhombi; objects built from boxes and cylinders; flows as dashed paths animated with stroke-dashoffset; optional FX.three with an orthographic camera at (1,1,1) for a rotating object; thin 2 px outlines in a darker shade only.
styles.composition: One system in the centre of the frame like a board-game piece; the camera reveals it layer by layer; labels on leader lines; the flow (data, water, money) is the hero.
styles.colour: Soft background #eef1f7; 3 hues with 3 shades each, e.g. blue #4c6ef5/#3b5bdb/#2f4ac0, coral #ff8a65/#f4704a/#d9583a, mint #63e6be/#38d9a9/#20b98d; dark text #1f2a44; one accent for the moving flow.
styles.type: Poppins 700 labels on small white tags with leader lines; titles Poppins 700 large, flat on the screen (never skewed onto the iso plane except small floor labels).
styles.motion: Pieces drop in from above and settle (back.out 1.2), layers slide apart to show the inside (exploded view), flows run along paths continuously, little figures walk in iso steps.
styles.camera: Orthographic only: slow pan across the board, zoom into one block, rotate the whole board in 90 degree steps.
styles.transitions: The board slides out and the next assembles; zoom into a block and it becomes the next scene; an exploded view collapsing.
styles.sound: Soft clicks as pieces snap in, a gentle marimba / pluck loop, whooshes on the flows.

tr.look: 30 derece açıdan düz vektör dünya: kutulardan makineler, binalar, borular, akışlar.
tr.type: Okla bağlı küçük beyaz etiketler; başlıklar ekranda düz durur.
tr.motion: Parçalar yukarıdan düşüp oturur, katmanlar açılıp içi görünür, akış hiç durmaz.
tr.sound: Yerine oturan parçaların tıkları, marimba, akışlarda yumuşak vınlama.
tr.avoid: Tilt-shift oyuncak dünya, perspektifli 3B, gerçekçi doku, ağır gradyan.

en.look: A flat vector world at a 30 degree angle: machines, buildings, pipes and flows made of boxes.
en.type: Small white tags on leader lines; titles stay flat on the screen.
en.motion: Pieces drop in and settle, layers explode apart to show the inside, the flow never stops.
en.sound: Soft snap clicks, marimba, whooshes along the flows.
en.avoid: Tilt-shift toy worlds, perspective 3D, realistic textures, heavy gradients.

styles.name: 8-bit pixel art
styles.essence: A retro video game screen: big square pixels, a 16-colour palette, sprite characters, tile backgrounds, dialog boxes that type out text, score counters; the topic becomes a level to play through.
styles.not: Not hand-drawn cartoon (that is retro_cel), not smooth vector with a pixel filter, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no soft shadows.
styles.render: Draw on a low-res grid (e.g. 120x213 cells of 9 px) in canvas with imageSmoothingEnabled=false or as CSS boxes; sprites from string maps; a fixed 16-colour palette (PICO-8 / Pyxel style); dithering with a 2x2 checker only; text in a pixel font built from a 5x7 bitmap or a blocky face; every position snapped to the pixel grid.
styles.composition: Game screens: a side-scroll level, a dialog box at the bottom with a portrait, a HUD at the top (score, lives, level), a big title screen with PRESS START.
styles.colour: PICO-8 like 16 colours: #000000 #1d2b53 #7e2553 #008751 #ab5236 #5f574f #c2c3c7 #fff1e8 #ff004d #ffa300 #ffec27 #00e436 #29adff #83769c #ff77a8 #ffccaa; backgrounds dark navy #1d2b53, accents yellow and red.
styles.type: Pixel caps only (bitmap font), text types out letter by letter in dialog boxes; numbers as score counters that roll up.
styles.motion: Stepped: sprites animate on 2-4 frame cycles at 8-12 fps, moves snap to whole pixels, jumps follow a parabola in steps, hits flash white for 2 frames, screen shake on impact.
styles.camera: Side-scrolling follow; a hard screen-by-screen flip like old games; a zoom only as an integer scale jump (x2, x4).
styles.transitions: Iris/circle wipe to black, a pixel dissolve (blocks), a 'LEVEL 2' title card, a door the hero walks through.
styles.sound: Chiptune: square and triangle waves, noise drums, coin and jump blips for events (the studio's own composer can play these).

tr.look: Retro oyun ekranı: iri kare pikseller, 16 renk, sprite karakterler, puan ve can göstergesi.
tr.type: Yalnız piksel büyük harf; diyalog kutusunda harf harf yazılır.
tr.motion: Basamaklı, piksele oturan hareket; vuruşta beyaz yanıp sönme ve ekran sarsıntısı.
tr.sound: Chiptune: kare dalga melodi, gürültü davul, jeton ve zıplama sesleri.
tr.avoid: El çizimi çizgi film, kenar yumuşatma, gradyan, bulanıklık.

en.look: A retro game screen: big square pixels, 16 colours, sprite characters, score and lives.
en.type: Pixel caps only; dialog text types out letter by letter.
en.motion: Stepped moves snapped to the pixel grid; white hit flashes and screen shake.
en.sound: Chiptune: square-wave tunes, noise drums, coin and jump blips.
